source_paper.title: A deep learning strategy to identify cell types across species from high-density extracellular recordings

evidence.locator: Figures 5C–F and 6; STAR Methods, Cell-type classification
evidence.supports: Original LOO classification, confidence/coverage, external expert-label comparison and paper/source identity.
LOO versus five-fold choices, ten runs, probability averaging and training-only oversampling.
Class ontology and waveform/ACG preparation route; current loader is not a verified original data manifest.

evidence.locator: Scope and preserved estimands; Why the literal baseline remains separate; Evidence and qualification

evidence.locator: OBLIGATIONS; ScientificDriver.classify, transfer and score_captured; programme/driver.py and programme/baselines.py
evidence.supports: Existing internal source retains full LOO, both external populations, classifier ablations, original baselines and explicit missing companion producers; it is not scientific execution evidence.

evidence.locator: programmes evaluation.py, captured_prediction.py and artifacts.py; CAPTURE_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md; source/public/OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json

target.description: Five-class cerebellar cell-type prediction; external mouse and macaque expert-label agreement remains a separate panel.

dataset.description: Public C4 HDF5 release is identified, but exact paper unit/source and checkpoint membership are not authenticated here.

cohort.description: 202 ground-truth classifier units; three granule cells are excluded from classification. Preserve full external mouse/macaque panels and distinguish optogenetic truth from expert labels.

split.description: Original classifier uses leave-one-unit-out with ten initializations per unit; external predictions average all 2020 members. Animal-held-out nesting is a separate extension.

inputs.description: Waveform, 3D autocorrelogram and cerebellar layer; no-layer ablation is a distinct original condition.

preprocessing.description: Recover exact QC, alignment, VAE exposure and original checkpoint/configuration lineage. The label-conditioned engineered feature route cannot be presented as target-blind prediction.

metric.description: Per-class correct predictions among retained units, together with retained fraction. Confidence is the largest mean class probability divided by the second largest; original threshold is 2 and threshold-0 results are also reported.

aggregation.description: Preserve all classwise confusion/coverage and external population results; a single macro-score and ordered joint acceptance rule have not been source-recovered.

full_panel.description: Preserve the complete five-class 202-unit ground-truth LOO panel, ten initializations per held unit, all 2020 deep members on both full external expert mouse and macaque populations, and original confidence-zero and confidence-two classwise accuracy/retained-fraction outputs. Required companion panels include original no-layer and all-photoactivated conditions, all three engineered-feature author baselines with their disclosed label-conditioned preprocessing, independent Purkinje truth comparisons and latent congruence. Exact companion cell definitions, thresholds, denominators and complete numerical figure/supplement outputs remain unbound; the declared primary cells are not an assertion of complete panel recovery. Retain F1-F4 source/QC/ground-truth provenance and distinguish descriptive F7 analyses from the classification endpoint.

permitted_observations.description: Original waveform, 3D ACG and layer observations with the separate no-layer condition; all observations of a left-out unit excluded from its classifier fit, training-only oversampling, and the original independent 3090-unit unlabeled VAE exposure. Preserve separate optogenetic ground truth and external expert labels. Recover exact preprocessing, VAE/checkpoint membership and protected-target ownership before paired delivery. Literal label-conditioned engineered-feature reproduction must be disclosed and operator-owned; it is not a target-blind candidate input. Both AI conditions receive the same paper and authentic data; verified author source is the only information addition.

blocking_issues: Authenticate all five original HDF5 sources, complete biological/QC dispositions, original 202-unit classifier panel and independent 3090-unit VAE membership, full external mouse/macaque panels and distinct truth provenance.

Recover the full original classwise confidence/coverage results, exact confidence-boundary convention, all confusion denominators and unavailable/undefined cells. No headline accuracy or single macro score can replace this vector.

Recover and separately enumerate every original no-layer, all-photoactivated, three-baseline, independent Purkinje-truth and latent-congruence companion output with exact metric, condition, numerical target and source locator. The sixty declared main cells do not close this companion-panel gap.

Resolve source-to-paper QC, waveform/ACG, layer, notebook/checkpoint and three-bit versus released head lineage; retain disclosure of label-conditioned engineered features and keep the grouped target-blind extension separate.

Freeze source-supported tolerances and uncertainty for every main and companion result after recovering biological dependence. Every expected value and criterion remains unresolved; no scientific minimum or tolerance is inferred from software tests.

Provide a runnable AI submitted-analysis interface and independent execution lineage using authentic complete inputs. The historical JSON prediction interface has only mouse LOO and ten-member monkey transfer, omits external mouse and lacks the full controls; it cannot serve as the complete reproduction interface.

Provide an independent source-native verifier of complete per-member probabilities, source-derived preparation/masks, fold/model identities, truth joins and all companion outputs; existing hash/readback and duplicate checks do not establish that a submitted program computed from authentic data.

Bind immutable cohort/split/full-panel/observation/metric/aggregation and data/interface/verifier manifests, common paired delivery and actual exposure/cumulative budgets. Static paper/code exports do not qualify participant isolation or data/target authority.
